next.reason: 1985: 'The same symbolic-character-1 must appear only once in a SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS clause.' §2023:12.3.7.3 SR16 a) says 'only once within the SYMBOLIC CHARACTER clauses of this SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph', but 1985 already refused a cross-clause repeat: symbolic-character is one of the disjoint sets of user-defined words and 'all user-defined words within a given disjoint set must be unique' (§1985:IV.4.2.2.1.1), and a symbolic-character cannot be qualified. The recheck did not consult that rule. Same programs refused.
